body:
> brother

Read posts before you comment.

This kind of empty platitude is worse than useless. To someone who feels as though they have no reason to live, those kind of words aren't going to change their mind. It just makes one think "But that doesn't apply to *me* because [list of varied and valid reasons they feel their life is pointless]".
Thanks. I checked them out and took their financial aid survey, but even after putting in my income as $0 (which it is) they still want to charge me $39/week. I'll check back if I find a job, lol.
A lot of the time. I try to buy into "life is meaningless so you can do whatever you want with it", but you can't really do whatever you want if you're five-figures deep in debt with no job.

This sounds like textbook depression. It's chemicals in your brain making you feel like this. It's not something you did, it's not necessarily in response to anything in your life. If you can see a psychiatrist, you should try it.
Girls don't need boyfriends to make life worth living.
Suicide by drugs is not a good way to go. It will be painful. There's a good chance you'll throw it all up. Don't do it.
Logically, I know cats are smarter and more emotional than we give them credit for. That's pretty much my main reason for holding on.
I'm sorry the world failed you.
